1.ja: ת'ם אקאם אל אסראיל פי שטין

1.en: and the people began to commit fornication

2.en: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their objects of worship

3.en: And the house of Israel attached itself to Pe'or the idol
and the anger of God intensified against them

4.en: 'Take all the chiefs of the people
and crucify them before God facing the sun

4.ja: וירגע שדה' ג'צ'ב אללה מן אל אסראיל
4.en: that the intensity of God's anger may turn away from the house of Israel

5.en: And Moses said to their judges

5.ja: יקתל כל רגל מן פי נאחיתה. מן מלאזמי פעור אלצנם
5.en: 'Let every man in his district kill whoever is attached to Pe'or the idol
5.he: הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר

6.ja: ואד'א ברגל מן בני אסראיל קד אקבל
6.en: And behold, a man from the sons of Israel had come forward

6.ja: וקדם אלי' מא בינהם אמראה מדיאנייה
6.en: and brought among them a Midianite woman
in the presence of Moses and their whole assembly

6.ja: והם יבכון. ענד באב כ'בא אלמחצ'ר
6.en: who were weeping at the door of the tent of the convocation

7.ja: פלמא ראא פינחס אבן אלעזר. אבן הרון אלאמאם
7.en: And when Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest saw
he arose from the midst of the assembly
and took a spear in his hand

8.en: And he went in after him into the chamber
and thrust both of them through
the man and the woman through her belly
and the pestilence was checked from the sons of Israel

9.ja: וכאן עדד מן מאת בד'אלך אלובא
9.en: And the number of those who died in that pestilence

10.en: Then God spoke to Moses, saying

11.ja: אן פנחס אבן אלעזר אבן הרון אלאמאם
11.en: 'Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest
has turned back My wrath from the sons of Israel

11.ja: במא ג'אר לי פי מא בינהם
11.en: in that he was zealous for My sake among them
so that I did not destroy them with My punishment

12.en: Behold, I am giving him My covenant of peace

13.en: And it shall be for him and for his offspring after him
in recompense for his zeal for his Lord
whereby he made atonement for the sons of Israel

14.en: And the name of the Israelite man who was slain
a noble of his father's house among the Simeonites

15.en: And the name of the slain Midianite woman

15.ja: והו רייס אהל בית אמתה במדין
15.en: he being the head of the people of his nation's household in Midian

16.en: Then God spoke to Moses, saying

18.en: for they are enemies to you, through their treachery
with which they have treacherously dealt against you by reason of Pe'or

18.ja: ובסבב כזבי אבנה' שריף מדין אכ'תהם
18.en: and by reason of Cozbi daughter of the noble of Midian their kinswoman

18.ja: אלמקתולה פי יום אלובא בסבב פעור
18.en: who was slain on the day of the pestilence on account of Pe'or
